title: Chapter 2755 - 105: Heavy Armor Formation
content:
Chapter 2755: Chapter 105: Heavy Armor Formation

Lugu stood tall, wearing sinister dark bone armor, with blood-red war paint on his face.

He was the General of the Shugu Main Department, his battle achievements illustrious, his power even surpassing the aging Chief Shugou.

This time, leading the expedition against the Wusha Mountain Realm was entirely in his hands.

Lugu had been through countless battles, and this assault on the Wusha, a Second Grade Mountain Realm, did not particularly concern him.

Yet at this moment, watching Dan Zhu and others retreat, thinking of the Formation he had seen, Lugu’s expression had turned solemn.

"These Holy Patterns, strangely unique, are not the inheritance of the Royal Court..."

"Could it be true, what Iron Skill Bone said?"

"Is the Shaman of the Danque Tribe truly a cunning human-skin Demon Monster?"

"On my Great Wilderness land, would a human-skin Demon Monster truly appear in broad daylight?"

In Lugu’s eyes, a fierce look emerged.

A trusted aide beside him spoke: "Lord Lugu, should we pursue?"

Lugu paused for a moment and said: "No need."

"But..." the aide hesitated, "Three Heavy Armored Soldiers were seized, wearing the ancestral Bone Heavy Armor..."

Lugu sneered, "And what of it if they were seized? The things left by the ancestors can’t easily fall into others’ hands."

The aide dared not speak further.

Lugu’s gaze hardened, and he said in a deep voice: "Pass the order to continue advancing, attack the mountains we encounter, kill the people we meet. This battle, they had other designs."

Lugu sneered, "Taking three Heavy Armors means we must exchange land for them. I want to see if Dan Zhu will settle this account."

"Yes." The aide passed down the command.

The Barbarian Soldiers of the Shugu Main Department began a massive advance.

Mo Hua’s order was initially "retreat," not hold.

Furthermore, they indeed were not a match for the Shugu Main Department at the moment, and could only retreat.

And General Lugu seized this moment, advancing decisively without any hesitation.

With no obstruction for the Shugu Main Department, their advance became rapidly swift, constantly assaulting mountains and occupying ridges, utterly invincible.

The Danque Tribe and Wutu Alliance could only keep retreating.

Moreover, defeat became a trend.

Defeat led to retreat, retreat led to defeat, and then continued retreat.

Dan Zhu and others retreated for an entire day and night, finally relying on a massive Wufeng Mountain Range cutting across the Wusha Mountain Realm to halt the defeat, confronting the Shugu Department.

By then, the Shugu Department had nearly occupied most of the Wusha Mountain Realm.

Even though Mo Hua had already ordered, in the capacity of Shaman, that all tribes within the Wusha Mountain Realm evacuate in advance.

People, food, and some valuables were left behind.

But in haste, many things couldn’t be moved.

For the Shugu Department, this was a great victory.

And the cost was merely three Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldiers and three sets of Bone Heavy Armor.

...

To the east of the Wusha Mountain Realm, still within the territory Mo Hua controlled.

At this moment, in a small tribal camp.

A wide tent had a newly built enclosed prison.

Three Bone Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldiers were detained, their bodies suppressed by Formation, their hands and feet shackled by chains.

Mo Hua, along with a group of Golden Core cultivators, prepared to thoroughly study these ancient Bone Heavy Armors passed down by the Shugu Department.

Mo Hua temporarily lifted the Formation.

The control of Gold, Water, and Earth triple Formation disappeared, and the drowning effect was canceled, allowing the three Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldiers to breathe anew.

Just as Mo Hua lifted the Formation.

One of the Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldiers, eyes resolute, uttered: "For the Barbarian God! For the Shugu Department! For the ancestors!"

After finishing, he bit down hard, severing his tongue, blood seeping from his mouth.

His vitality was thus cut off.

And the Bone Heavy Armor on him flashed with a deep luster, its Monster Qi surging and twisting, before exploding and shattering instantly.

Dan Zhu sensed danger, immediately flashing to shield Mo Hua.

Barbarian General Chi Feng and Bachuan’s two Elders stood in front of Dan Zhu.

The Bone Heavy Armor exploded, the armor shattered into fragments, and the Barbarian Soldier inside burst into a blood mist.

Fragments carried the blood mist, spreading in the prison with the residual power of the explosion, painting the ground red and leaving walls and stone pillars mottled.

Mo Hua remained motionless.

In front of him, Dan Zhu and people like Chi Feng shielded him from the explosion’s force.

And when the explosion stopped, the smokey wind cleared.

The Shugu Department Barbarian Soldier had already "self-destructed" along with the armor, reduced to pieces.

Everyone’s expressions changed.

Almost simultaneously, they heard another Shugu Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldier muttering:

"For the Barbarian God! For the Shu..."

Mo Hua immediately said: "Stop him!"

As Mo Hua spoke, the blood-streaked Barbarian General Chi Feng rushed up, quickly grasping the neck of the Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldier, cutting him off.

Without finishing his words, without reciting "For the Shugu Department, for the ancestors," the Shugu Department Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldier appeared somewhat regretful.

Then his face contorted, heedless of Chi Feng’s strength, suddenly biting down to sever his own tongue.

Ordinary cultivators wouldn’t die from severing a tongue.

But these Heavy Armored Soldiers of the Shugu Department seemed to have learned some "Witchcraft," and with the tongue severed, life quickly vanished.

As life extinguished, the Bone Qian Man Heavy Armor also subsequently exploded and self-destructed.

And this time, the explosive power was strong, with Chi Feng the closest.

Even though he was at Mid-stage Golden Core Cultivation, he was blown away by the self-destruction of the heavy armor, flying more than thirty feet, his armor shattered, his body covered in wounds.

After two consecutive Heavy Armor explosions, not only Chi Feng but even Dan Zhu and others in the distance were momentarily stunned by the shock.
